known_schema_gap: Formal L1 simulation task representation, engine-specific semantic adapters and SFT release remain unimplemented. The simulation receipt schema is local intake/byte verification only and is not formal L1 admission.
simulation_receipt_validation_scope: declared metadata, local artifact bytes, bounded structural truth-key check; not scientific validation
simulation_receipt_scope: local receipt metadata, bounded structural leakage checks and local artifact byte/hash verification; not source authentication, physics validation, native engine certification or L1/SFT admission
diagram_text_regions_scope: one provenance-bound unresolved candidate per OCR line; verbatim OCR text only; no component, port, connector, hierarchy or fault inference
diagram_text_review_scope: bind local reviewer-supplied decisions to exact candidate/source/asset hashes and evidence locators; reviewer identity is not authenticated; no graph import or training authorization
